vetSays.line: A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.

You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling A man, maybe 50s about A person, maybe 40s, with grey-streaked hair. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.)
👀 "ER nurse, huh?" the person in their 40s, with a scarred cheek, the er nurse nods — then, an hour later, drops a shop-talk detail no ER nurse would ever get right. They catch themselves. Too late.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek).
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Right. Let's do it, then. Talking doesn't chop wood."
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek eats from the pantry.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Jose, Elena, Oliver and Aline met them at the door — 4 put down. Jose, Elena, Oliver, Aline are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. 📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Flashbulb Moth falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Flashbulb Moth!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikos just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Brian just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Zoltan taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Zoltan drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zoltan just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
